title: Change of Subject in Algebraic Formulas

blocks.text: Have you ever needed to rearrange a formula to solve for a different variable? This skill is crucial in mathematics and science!

blocks.markdown: In mathematics, changing the subject of a formula involves rearranging the equation so that a different variable is isolated on one side. This is a useful skill when you need to solve for a specific variable given certain conditions.

blocks.title: Change of Subject
blocks.text: Changing the subject of a formula means rearranging the equation to make a specified variable the subject.

blocks.markdown: Consider the formula for velocity: $v = u + at$. If we need to make $a$ the subject, we rearrange the formula to $a = \frac{v - u}{t}$.

blocks.title: Example: Rearranging a Formula
blocks.prompt: Rearrange the formula $A = \pi r^2$ to make $r$ the subject.

steps.text: Take the square root of both sides: $r = \sqrt{\frac{A}{\pi}}$.

blocks.markdown: It's important to follow the rules of algebra when changing the subject, such as performing the same operation on both sides of the equation.

blocks.title: Exam Tip
blocks.text: Always check your final formula by substituting known values to ensure it works correctly.

points: Changing the subject involves isolating the desired variable.
Apply inverse operations to both sides of the equation consistently.
